title: No upper bound check on 'len' in non-LICHEN_LINK path of lichen_l2_input()
close_reason: The non-LICHEN_LINK code path no longer exists. The #else branch handling raw IPv6 was removed, and CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK is now mandatory (enforced with #error at compile time at lines 83-85). Current lichen_l2_input() validates input length at lines 1815-1822 with proper bounds checking against LICHEN_MIN_FRAME_LEN and MAX_LORA_FRAME.
